rule: Subject numeric ID divisible by 5 reserved; all other subjects development. Fixed once before any new candidate.
freeze_context: Frozen baseline running; manual source-image review so far includes subject 001 only. Subject 002 partial scalar baseline outcomes observed. Both are development.
use: No changes to current full baseline. Future candidate selection uses development only. Reserve queries excluded from fitting and manual failure-driven changes until candidate source/model hashes frozen.
exposure_limits: Full baseline aggregate results may be read; reserve is prospective protection from subsequent optimization, not a claim of a never-evaluated fully blind baseline.
gallery: Complete eligible fixed five-frame gallery remains together, including reserved identities. Enrollment frames are references, not target-query training data.
acceptance: Report actual correct, wrong, rejected, processing errors, lost previously-correct cases and timings. Rejecting a wrong answer is not a correct identification.
non_goals: No threshold scans on reserved queries
No Pi speed claims from Windows
